fields.Name: CRD-10 - Responses
fields.Description: Verify standard response draft, confirmation, reopen, withdrawal, locking, concurrency, and subject isolation: SaveResponse sets Drafted/Human or Empty; ConfirmResponse requires self-assessment and Applicant actor and stamps ConfirmedByUserID/ConfirmedAt; confirmed and submitted responses cannot be saved or confirmed, including via generated GraphQL update mutation over the wire; parallel ConfirmResponse with same ExpectedUpdatedAt allows only one; ReopenResponse requires Staff and reason; WithdrawApplication sets Withdrawn and allows re-invitation; second contact of same subject can save while another subject's contact gets Record not found.
